entries.land_location_as_stated: in a rural setting, close to a beautiful, trout-stocked stream, and ruby gem mines; in the heart of the Smokies
entries.description: A guest house and women-owned vacation cottages in a rural setting in Franklin, North Carolina, offering overnight and weekly accommodations. Welcomes lesbian women, girl children, and boy children.
entries.raw_text: VANGUARD ENTERPRISES PO Box 1082, Franklin, NC 28734 (704)524-4453. Vanguard Guest House is a private home nestled in a rural setting, close to a beautiful, trout-stocked stream, and ruby gem mines. Accommodations include private room and bath, full kitchen privileges, shared common areas, living room with fireplace, and spacious deck (constructed by local women!). Warm, relaxed, friendly atmosphere where everyone is free to be themselves. Rates: $35 per night. Also, private, women-owned vacation cottages and homes in this area are available. Various styles, views, and locations. Most can house minimally four persons, and have decks and fireplaces. They have fully equipped kitchens and linens are provided. Smoking is an outside activity in most of the cottages. Rates range from $200 to $300 per week. Franklin is in the heart of the Smokies and a wonderful place to base your vacation. We welcome girl/boy children.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is a guest house and vacation rental service ('Vanguard Guest House... vacation cottages and homes'). Land city and state inferred from 'Franklin is in the heart of the Smokies' and 'in this area'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred because this is a questionnaire-directory listing that welcomes guests; Girl children and Boy children from 'We welcome girl/boy children'.

entries.description: A year-round rental cabin in Pisgah National Forest near Asheville, North Carolina, hosted by one lesbian woman, offering accessible accommodations in the woods.
entries.raw_text: BEAR'S CABIN c/o Ruth Bone, 70 St Dunstans Circle, Asheville, NC 28803 (704)254-0024 (after 5:30pm). Cozy and magical cabin in Pisgah National Forest. Exquisite. Private. Safe. Totally and tastefully furnished with antiques, women's artwork, women's books, waterbed, fireplace (and oil heat), phone, kitchen, bath. Year round. $45/day. Asheville is a resort area with a large lesbian population. I am/have: 1 lesbian, accessible, woods.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is a rental cabin offered to visitors by the day ('$45/day'). Mailing address is a street address in Asheville, while the cabin is 'in Pisgah National Forest', so land_street_address, land_city, and land_zip are left blank; land_state is NC. 'I am/have: 1 lesbian' is not counted in num_residents because the listing does not say she lives at the cabin. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from questionnaire directory and 'I am/have: 1 lesbian'. Focuses: Disabled women coded from 'accessible' (or noted; questionnaire 'accessible' indicates accessibility). Note: Smoking not mentioned.

entries.description: A women's campground in the woods on the Etowah River in Georgia, with women living on the land and primitive campsites.
entries.raw_text: SWIFTWATERS CAMPGROUND FOR WOMEN Box 2068, Dahlonega, GA 30533 (404)864-3229. Swiftwaters is a quiet place to camp on the headwaters of the Etowah River, deep in the woods. Plenty of tables, fire rings, and primitive river-front campsites. We welcome dogs (if friendly). We have: outhouse, woods, camping space, women living on the land.

entries.land_location_as_stated: on the beach directly in front of us; ocean
entries.description: A residential lesbian community of 10 cottages with 15 resident lesbians and a cultural/spiritual center with guest rooms and a feminist library on the ocean in St. Augustine, Florida. Only lesbian women may rent or own, while non-lesbian women and girl children are welcome as visitors and members.
entries.raw_text: THE PAGODA 2854 Coastal Hwy Vilano Beach, St Augustine, FL 32084 (904)824-2970. We are a small residential lesbian community (10 separately owned cottages) with a cultural/spiritual center. Only lesbians can rent or own, but all wommin are welcome to become members and stay in one of our four bedrooms in the center, as well as use our feminist library and health food store. Rules in our 2-story center: no smoking, no alcohol on main floor, no cooking or eating of meat, fish or fowl on main floor. We have a BBQ pit and flesh may be eaten elsewhere in the building. No nudity on our property or on the beach directly in front of us. We welcome: new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women visitors. We are/have: 15 resident lesbians, 90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country, ocean, women living and working on the land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because it calls itself a 'residential lesbian community' first. Land address copied from street address. num_residents is 15 from '15 resident lesbians' (the '90 lesbian/nonlesbian members from all over the country' are non-resident). Accepted groups: Lesbian women ('Only lesbians can rent or own', '15 resident lesbians'), Non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women visitors', '90 lesbian/nonlesbian members'), Girl children ('girl children'). Focuses: Lesbian separatism ('Only lesbians can rent or own'), Spirituality/ritual ('cultural/spiritual center'), Archives/cultural work ('cultural/spiritual center', 'feminist library'), Recovery/substance-free ('no smoking, no alcohol on main floor').

entries.land_location_as_stated: less than an hour from the ocean shore
entries.description: A bed and breakfast facility with a swimming pool and exercise room in Orlando, Florida, welcoming lesbian women and non-lesbian women.
entries.raw_text: SAFARI SOUTH 4310 S Semoran Blvd Suite 661, Orlando, FL 32822 (407)282-7847. Florida is America's favorite pastime and Safari South is in its heartland. Minutes from world-famous attractions and less than an hour from the ocean shore, we offer bed and breakfast accommodations ranging from single room with shared bath to whole house availability. Each unit offers AC/heat, TV/radio, and continental breakfast in a facility with swimming pool and exercise room. We welcome nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it offers 'bed and breakfast accommodations'. Mailing street address has 'Suite 661' (a commercial mail/office suite), so land_street_address and land_zip are left blank; land_city is Orlando and land_state is FL from the text. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from questionnaire directory; Non-lesbian women from 'We welcome nonlesbian women'.

entries.description: A bed and breakfast in Orlando, Florida, with a resident couple offering private rooms and shared kitchen to guests.
entries.raw_text: CLADDAGH COTTAGE B & B PO Box 574081, Orlando, FL 32857-4081 (407)282-4146. A bit of o'Ireland in Orlando. Private entrance, bath, LR & BR. Shared kitchen with resident couple. Full breakfast you fix at your convenience. Info and directions to local "scene," attractions, and night life. 1-3 persons is $29-$63 per night with discounts and specials for longer visit. Central heat and A/C, TV & Atari, off-street parking. "You'll be back if you try us once."
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is a bed and breakfast ('CLADDAGH COTTAGE B & B'). Mailing address is a PO Box; land_city is Orlando and land_state is FL from 'in Orlando'. num_residents is 2 from 'resident couple'. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from questionnaire directory.

entries.land_location_as_stated: Lots of woods, birds, tropical vegetation
entries.description: A smoke-free bed and breakfast in a private home with woods and tropical vegetation in Miami, Florida.
entries.raw_text: TROPICAL DREAMS BED'N'BREAKFAST c/o C Brewer, 7600 SW 50 Ave, Miami, FL 33143 (305)666-5203. We're a private home offering an alternative to male-owned commercial hotels. We have one suite consisting of a bedroom, full bath and living room with a sofa bed. Also one double room with (sometimes shared) bath. This one has a wall of sliding glass doors that open out onto our deck. Lots of woods, birds, tropical vegetation, racoons, cats. Quiet, restful, smoke-free. Convenient to airport, beaches, Everglades, all tourist attractions and the road to Key West.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because it is a bed and breakfast ('BED'N'BREAKFAST... offering an alternative to male-owned commercial hotels'). Land address copied from street address. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from questionnaire directory. 'smoke-free' alone is not coded as Recovery/substance-free per codebook.

entries.land_location_as_stated: just off I-71, 50 miles south of Cleveland, 90 miles north of Columbus; a pond; woods; near Amish country, herb farms
entries.description: A rural guest and camping space in West Salem, Ohio, with guest rooms, a cabin, tenting, gardens, a pond, woods, and a summer music festival. Welcomes lesbian women, non-lesbian women, and girl children.
entries.raw_text: DEGREES OF FREEDOM 10055 Kline Rd RD #2, W Salem, OH 44287 (just off I-71, 50 miles south of Cleveland, 90 miles north of Columbus). We have two guest rooms and bath, two platform tents, a cabin that sleeps four, picnic shelter with fireplace, gardens (herb, vegetable, fruit, and flower), a pond for swimming, fishing, boating, skating, and studying pond life, places for tenting, woods, and a summer music festival July 22-24, '88. We're near Amish country, herb farms. You can cook out, go to town to eat (1 mile), cook in, or take potluck with the household. Donations appreciated for overnight stays (guest room $11, cabin $7, platform tent $4, camping $2/person). Work exchange available. We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space because the listing focuses on guest accommodations, camping, and a summer music festival ('two guest rooms and bath, two platform tents, a cabin... Donations appreciated for overnight stays'). Land address copied from street/rural route address. Accepted groups: Lesbian women inferred from questionnaire directory; Girl children and Non-lesbian women from 'We welcome: girl children, nonlesbian women'. Focuses: Archives/cultural work coded for hosting 'a summer music festival'.
